claim: The miner/metal ratio tilt (F366200, F366201), as a daily forward paper record of 0.5 x (GDX/GLD tilt book minus its 50/50 book) + 0.5 x (SIL/SLV tilt book minus its 50/50 book), net of costs, continuing the recorded 2016-2026 books. Evidence for promotion or closure, decided by a pre-stated sequential test.

evaluation.checks: on anniversaries of the window's opening only; the first (365 days) decides nothing by itself
evaluation.promotion_means: a decision debate on a route that admits on forward evidence; it cannot admit by itself

rule.execution: decided at a close, executed at the next open
rule.schedule: 21 tranches; tranche k decides on sessions whose index from anchor_session is k mod 21
rule.tilt: commodity_classes.ratio_point(miner, metal): z60 of log(TR miner / TR metal), miner weight clip(0.5 - 0.25 z, 0, 1)

status: forward watch; not an admission candidate: gate rules v2 cannot admit it, because its development stage charges the 1401-statistic discovery atlas as prior search
void_conditions: a change to the index or objective of GDX, GLD, SIL or SLV
a merger or delisting of any of them
window_opens: the first session after this spec reaches origin/development
